fields.reported: CARD treats k1–k5 as the RMS span at an amplitude obtained by inverting the lower envelope.

checked.valid: These are broad conditional geometric RMS bounds at that fixed amplitude under the stated area approximation.
checked.limit: Different widths generally have different knockdowns. The span is not an iso-knockdown curve and does not show that every width attains the requested kd.
checked.source: Lee section 7 and Fig. 6(c) supply the minimizing width kc(alpha); Eq. 23 alone omits this information.
checked.radii: Be-015 and Be-021b lie between the two computed R/t values; P2-E and Be-021 lie outside that interval. None exactly equals a computed radius.

fields.followup: Label the range conditional geometric bounds; use the source critical-width curve, or new calculations, when an envelope-associated RMS is required.
